summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K reporting treasury share holdings under Article 11 of CVM Resolution 44/2021, disclosing 27 Class A preferred shares held in treasury with no securities or derivative operations during the month. The filing includes only a standard forward-looking statement disclaimer and no transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation. This is an ordinary monthly Brazilian securities-reporting disclosure analogous to a US issuer's routine share-repurchase or treasury-status notice, not a special situation; no deal terms apply and no risk-arb angle exists.
